AdjustmentMethod.description: Method used to apply discount. Valid values are: • Range—Apply the discount to all items after you reach the discount tier. For example, suppose that you give a 10% discount for 50 or more items. If a customer orders 50 products, and the type is range, apply the 10% discount to all 50 items. • Slab—Apply discounts in tiers. For example, suppose that you order 30 products, and the type is slab, you can apply a 10% discount to units 1–9, a 20% discount to units 10–19, and a 30% discount to units 20–30.
